mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered David's most important accomplishment."

Deuteronomy refers to both priests and Levites as Levitical priests thus grouping them together.

Invention refers to the "proofs" and "refutations" of a speech or writing.

Miscall is an Old Testament scholar who has read Genesis 12 and 1 Samuel 16-22 from a deconstructionist perspective.

The Creator is the regulator of worship, and not the creature.

The critical spirit means that every man has a perfect right to discredit traditional conclusions if he can do it by scientific methods.

The reality of God is the main focus of the Old Testament.

The temple is a house of prayer for all nations (1Kings8:41; Isa.56:7).

Different Hebrew words are used to express the meaning of sin in the Old Testament.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those whose sins have been atoned for, so that they are free to minister to other sinners."
Priests are those whose sins have been atoned for, so that they are free to minister to other sinners.
